segments.text: The password for bandit seven is somewhere on the whole filesystem: a file owned by user bandit seven, in group bandit six, exactly thirty-three bytes.
I log in as bandit6 with ssh bandit6@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
I run find from the root, filtering on user, group, and exact size in bytes, sending the flood of permission denied errors to dev null.
Exactly one path matches: var lib dpkg info slash bandit seven dot password.
It prints the password for bandit seven, and the level is solved.
